content.rendered:
The next business meeting of the SSD Board of Directors will be held on Wednesday, January 19, 2022. As the Board and District staff continue to focus on prioritizing in-person learning for all SSD schools during the current surge of COVID-19 cases in our district, this month’s regular meeting will be held virtually and will have an abbreviated agenda. This month’s work session will be canceled. All public meetings of the Board of Directors can be viewed live at the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.

6:30 pm – Executive Session (held under ORS 192.660 (2)(d) Negotiations) (Non-public meeting)

7:00 pm – Regular Meeting (Virtual meeting – accessible via live stream)

The agenda for this meeting can be viewed here.

Public comment can be submitted in advance of this meeting for Board member review. To submit public comment, please use the attached form. All submitted public comment must be received by 3:00pm on Wednesday, January 19. For this abbreviated virtual meeting only, public comment will not be read aloud, but will be forwarded to all Board members in advance of the 7:00pm meeting.

The purpose of public comment is for members of our Board of Directors to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Board members will not respond to submitted public comment.
